title: B10: Verify (and fix if needed) StepsView multi-section rendering
description: After B1 and B2 land, the parser emits 3 sections for the Pasta Bolognese fixture. Verify that the existing StepsView.swift already renders section headers with per-section step numbering per its 0004 AC. If it does: document in the bead handoff that no code change was needed. If it does NOT: apply the minimal fix to StepsView.swift so each section name appears as a header and step numbering restarts at 1 per section. Document which case applied.
acceptance_criteria: Parsing Pasta Bolognese fixture produces 3 sections with names 'Getting the meat browned', 'Preparing the sofrito', 'Finishing the sauce and cooking the pasta'
Steps tab renders a visible header for each section name
Step numbering restarts at 1 in each named section
If StepsView.swift required a fix, the change is minimal and targeted
Bead handoff explicitly states whether a code change was made
